title: Qalam Academic Clone
desc: A feature-rich clone of the official Qalam academic management portal used at NUST. Streamlines student course registration, academic performance monitoring, and assignment portals.
features: Implemented full-featured student portal clone handling active course schedules and grade tracking sheets.
Engineered secure token-based user authentication and route verification for student vs. administrator profiles.
Designed dynamic REST API endpoints using Express to serve student data from a structured MongoDB database.

title: Bank Management System
desc: A transactional banking database system supporting accounts management, fund transfers, and ledger statements. Features dual interface portals for tellers and banking customers.
features: Created a full-featured accounts ledger database resolving concurrent bank transactions and record history.
Built a role-based authentication model separating client logins from bank manager administrative capabilities.
Constructed reliable Express REST interfaces using connection pooling to read/write transactions into a normalized MySQL schema.

title: Library Management System
desc: A modular library index system supporting catalog search, borrower registration, item reserves, and dynamically computed fine logs. Designed using strict Object-Oriented principles.
features: Programmed structured catalog indexes handling full CRUD operations for book inventory, logs, and user cards.
Designed dynamic algorithms to calculate late-return fines and update member borrowing states on login.
Normalized MySQL database schemas up to 3NF to avoid record redundancies and ensure data integrity.

title: PromptForge Workspace
desc: A full-stack AI prompt engineering platform that helps users create, refine, and manage prompts for large language models. It provides a comprehensive solution for prompt management, leveraging advanced technologies for a seamless user experience.
features: Engineered a responsive and modern UI with React and Tailwind CSS for enhanced user interaction
Developed a robust REST API using Node.js and Express, handling authentication, prompt storage, and AI integration logic
Integrated Groq's Llama 3.3 70B model for real-time prompt generation and improvement, leveraging low-latency inference

title: Interactive Portfolio Shell
desc: A high-performance modern developer portfolio. Features a retro bash shell terminal, custom 3D card tilt parallax, animated canvas particles, and instant contact mail routing.
features: Programmed a complete terminal shell emulator processing basic console commands (`help`, `about`, `projects`).
Designed custom 3D card-tilt mechanics tracking cursor vectors and a morphing shape avatar displaying a hover code overlay.
Integrated serverless contact mail submission routing query parameters to a live Gmail account.

title: Smart Fashion Store
desc: An intelligent e-commerce catalog application featuring dynamic product management, user authentication, secure dashboards, and AI-driven outfit recommendations.
features: Designed dynamic database models (User, Product, OutfitRecommendation) using SQLAlchemy for robust relational schemas.
Created a secure role-based session authentication system using Werkzeug password hashing and Flask-Login.
Developed an interactive administration control panel to catalog fashion products and schedule personalized outfit recommendations.
